definitions.explanation: The four seasons of the year: spring, summer, autumn, and winter. A culturally important concept in Japan, where seasonal awareness permeates daily life, food, art, and customs.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}には{四季|しき}がある。
{四季|しき}の{変化|へんか}を{楽|たの}しむ。
examples.english: To enjoy the changes of the four seasons.

examples.japanese: この{庭園|ていえん}は{四季|しき}それぞれの{美|うつく}しさがあり、{一年|いちねん}を{通|とお}して{訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}を{魅了|みりょう}している。
examples.english: This garden has beauty in each of the four seasons and captivates visitors throughout the year.

notes:
Seasonal awareness ({季節感|きせつかん}) is deeply embedded in Japanese culture, influencing food, greetings, poetry, and art. The phrase {四季|しき}{折々|おりおり} means 'each season' or 'throughout the seasons.' Japanese people often take pride in the distinctness of the four seasons.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{四季|しき}{折々|おりおり}: each season, throughout the seasons
・{四季|しき}の{移|うつ}り{変|か}わり: the changing of the seasons
・{四季|しき}を{感|かん}じる: to feel the seasons
